items.title: Charles Elgar Interview, 1958-05-27
items.q: Your teacher was Louie. Yeah. Louie Teos. He's the one I think they usually call Papa Teos. ... Yeah, that's right. That's right. Louie's the one we used to call Papa Teos.

ctx.x: Your teacher was Louie. Yeah. Louie Teos. He's the one I think they usually call Papa Teos.
